statements.impact_statement: The read-only WGDashboard guard disables OIDC (admin_enable=false, client_enable=false) and returns an inert response from /api/oidc/providers. jwt.decode is reached only from DashboardOIDC.VerifyToken, which is not in the shipped execution path.
ecdsa is present only as a transitive dependency of python-jose. The reviewed application source has no direct ECDSA import, and OIDC is disabled in the shipped read-only configuration.

The affected parser is golang.org/x/net/html. The reviewed amneziawg-go source tree has no import of net/html; the package appears only in unrelated cached modules that are not linked into the shipped binary.
